 "command": "mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-259d2349.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    all_cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)]
    # Uniform full rows/columns are the tile dividers.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Divider colors are found by uniform lines; exclude them when determining background.
    divider_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
            if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols]
    background = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    row_bands = []
    start = 0
    for r in sep_rows:
        if start < r: row_bands.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    if start < h: row_bands.append((start, h))
    col_bands = []
    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols:
        if start < c: col_bands.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    if start < w: col_bands.append((start, w))
    tiles = []
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_bands):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_bands):
            tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            score = sum(v != background for row in tile for v in row)
            tiles.append((score, ri, ci, tile))
    _, src_ri, src_ci, source = max(tiles, key=lambda x: x[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for _, ri, ci, _ in tiles:
        r0, r1 = row_bands[ri]
        c0, c1 = col_bands[ci]
        for dr in range(r1-r0):
            for dc in range(c1-c0):
                out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = source[dr][dc]
    return out
PY
